text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Alright! Training is over! So about that reward... please!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"It showed up in this morning's training fortune!
'Sparkling, raking it in, standing by'... Which means—"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Hii! Is zere somesing I can do for you~?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah, Taiki-san! No, that's not it! I wasn't calling you just now...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"No... Could it be that you get a 'heaping bundle'
of 'sparkly' things from 'Taiki'-san?"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! Raking in my shiny things!
In that case, I will give you a very special one, yes!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: (Ooh! A special sparkle straight from the American Taiki herself... I smell a gold mine!)

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Run alongside me,
and let's break a ton of sparkling sweat together~♪

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
T-Tandem training!?
I mean, sure, there are tons of shiny rewards, but...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
A-Aha! I'd love to, really, but
when it comes to running, I need my Trainer's permission...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
What do you think!? Running alongside Taiki-san,
...or a reward from you, Trainer?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Gyaboon!
I kinda had a feeling though~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Matikanefukukitaru tackled her extra training
with everything she had.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yay! I worked super hard today, after all!
I wonder what kind of sparkling reward it'll be~âª

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh? "A sparkling big reward for Taiki"â
was that what we were talking about??

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As things progressed, I ended up treating both of them
to several shiny... canned drinks as a reward.
